v1.3.54v1.3.54当前版本 · 球杆预览改用游戏内真实球杆Current · cue preview now uses the real in-game cue
v1.3.54 · 球杆预览改用游戏内真实球杆模型
· 问题：球杆主题的全屏 3D 预览此前自己维护了一套"简化模型"：总长 5.0、杆尾半径 0.28，长径比只有 8.9:1，配色也只用卡片上的两个色值铺色。而游戏内真实球杆（src/view/cue.ts + cuemesh.ts）是全长 R*43、杆尾半径 (R*0.23)/0.5，长径比 46.7:1（与真实球杆 147cm/3cm≈49:1 一致），杆身与杆尾各挂一张 256×1024 的程序化分区贴图。粗细差了 5 倍多，所以预览里那根"一眼就不是真实球杆"。
· 做法：新增 tools/cue-textures/，把游戏内的 cuetexturefactory.ts（19 个主题的贴图工厂）与 settings.ts 原样打包成 dist/cue-texture-factory.js（挂 window.CueGameCue，three 走 external→window.THREE，故不含 three、仅 45KB），预览直接取用真实贴图与真实几何参数，而不是照着抄一份。该构建已并入 npm run build，源码改了产物会自动更新。
· 对齐细节：四段圆柱 cueButt/cueShaft/cueFerrule/cueTip，比例 0.28/0.71/0.007 + 皮头厚 0.0055，周向分段 9，半径系数（杆尾顶端 ×0.9、皮头顶端 ×0.93）与游戏内一致；材质走 MeshPhongMaterial 并对齐 applyCueTheme()——有贴图时基色置白，auto（随台面）时按 shade(台呢色, +0.12/−0.28) 派生，光泽取主题 finish、无 finish 且无贴图时回落 50/80。几何按真实尺寸建好后整体缩放到预览世界尺度，相机/地面/倒影等既有常量全部沿用。
· 清理：预览里那份 THEMES 配置表与木纹/皮革/金属绘制器（约 680 行）已无引用，一并删除，从根源杜绝"预览与实机两套外观再次跑偏"；cue-preview-3d.js 由 65.6KB / 1640 行降到 42.2KB / 953 行。
· 修复 ①：切主题时 disposeTree() 原先会连 material.map 一起销毁，改用全局缓存贴图后这会让再次切回该主题的球杆变纯黑。现只 dispose geometry 与 material，贴图由工厂统一持有。
· 修复 ②：预览关闭状态下转屏，resize 时浮层 display:none 导致 clientWidth=0，relayout() 退回 200×140 兜底并把朝向算错；再打开预览就沿用这套错误值（缓冲 200×140 被拉伸到全屏、aspect 1.429）。现改为重建后补一次 _resize()。
· 说明：「随台面」主题在暗色桌台（黑曜石黑、熔岩裂纹等）下会很暗，这是它由台呢色派生的真实表现，与对局中一致；换亮色桌台或选其余 18 款自带贴图的主题即可看到明亮杆身。
约束：仅改展示层（预览渲染与资源打包），不改动任何物理逻辑、挥杆动画、碰撞参数，也不改游戏内球杆本身的行为。 v1.3.54 · Cue preview now reuses the real in-game cue
· Issue: the fullscreen 3D cue preview kept its own simplified model — 5.0 long with a 0.28 butt radius, a length-to-diameter ratio of just 8.9:1 — colored from two flat swatches on the card. The real in-game cue (src/view/cue.ts + cuemesh.ts) is R*43 long with a (R*0.23)/0.5 butt radius, 46.7:1 (matching a real 147cm/3cm cue at ~49:1), with a 256×1024 procedural texture on both shaft and butt. The preview was over 5× too fat, so it never looked like an actual cue.
· Fix: added tools/cue-textures/, which bundles the game's own cuetexturefactory.ts (all 19 themes) and settings.ts as-is into dist/cue-texture-factory.js (window.CueGameCue; three is an external mapping to window.THREE, so the bundle ships no three and weighs 45KB). The preview now pulls the real textures and real geometry parameters instead of hand-copying them, and the step is wired into npm run build so the artifact can never drift from source again.
· Alignment: four cylinders — cueButt/cueShaft/cueFerrule/cueTip — at 0.28/0.71/0.007 plus a 0.0055 tip, 9 radial segments, with the same radius factors as the game (butt top ×0.9, tip top ×0.93). Materials are MeshPhongMaterial matching applyCueTheme(): white base when a texture is present, shade(clothColor, +0.12/−0.28) for auto (follow-table), and shininess from the theme's finish falling back to 50/80. Geometry is built at true scale then uniformly scaled to the preview's world size, so all existing camera/floor/reflection constants still hold.
· Cleanup: the leftover THEMES table and wood/leather/metal painters (~680 lines) had no remaining callers and were deleted, removing the root cause of preview/gameplay divergence. cue-preview-3d.js went from 65.6KB / 1,640 lines to 42.2KB / 953 lines.
· Bugfix ①: disposeTree() used to dispose material.map as well. With globally cached textures that freed the GPU resource still held in cache, turning the cue pure black the next time you switched back. It now disposes only geometry and material.
· Bugfix ②: rotating the device while the preview was closed meant resize fired while the overlay was display:none, so clientWidth was 0 and relayout() fell back to 200×140 with the wrong orientation — and reopening reused those stale values (a 200×140 buffer stretched fullscreen, aspect 1.429). Rebuilds now call _resize().
· Note: the "Follow table" (auto) theme looks very dark on dark tables (Obsidian Black, Lava Cracks, …) because its color is derived from the cloth — exactly as it appears in a real match. Pick a bright table skin, or any of the other 18 textured cue themes, for a brighter shaft.
Constraint: presentation layer only (preview rendering and asset bundling) — no physics, swing animation, or collision parameters changed, and the in-game cue itself behaves exactly as before.
